categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and directly modifies peer orphan transaction resolution and message processing logic.
categories.rationale: Mitigates a potential message-processing thread stall by avoiding redundant parent lookups for peers that cannot be added as resolution candidates. Author benchmarks show processing time for an inv announcing 12 high-input orphans from an over-budget peer drops from 14.5–16.2 ms to ~0.2 ms.
